guides.definition: fetch returns a promise for a Response. HTTP error statuses still produce responses, so code should check ok before consuming and trusting the body.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The async function that performs the request.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The request URL, relative or absolute.

examples.title: Load an API status
examples.explanation: The function rejects non-success HTTP responses and returns the promise produced by parsing a successful JSON body.
